cases.code:
<template>
  <view class="report-page">
    <u-form :model="query">
      <u-form-item label="开始日期" prop="startDate">
        <u-input v-model="query.startDate" placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" type="text" />
      </u-form-item>
      <u-form-item label="结束日期" prop="endDate">
        <u-input v-model="query.endDate" placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" type="text" />
      </u-form-item>
      <u-form-item label="报表类型" prop="type">
        <u-input v-model="query.type" placeholder="请输入类型" type="text" />
      </u-form-item>
    </u-form>
    <scroll-view scroll-y class="list">
      <view v-for="item in list" :key="item.id" class="row">
        <text>{{ item.title }}</text>
        <text>{{ item.time }}</text>
      </view>
    </scroll-view>
    <u-button type="primary" size="large" text="查询" @click="onQuery" />
    <u--button type="primary" text="导出" @click="onExport" />
  </view>
</template>
<script setup>
const query = { startDate: '', endDate: '', type: '' };
const list = [];
const onQuery = () => { uni.showToast({ title: '查询中' }); };
const onExport = () => {
  uni.request({
    url: 'https://example.com/api/export',
    method: 'POST',
    data: query,
    success: (res) => { console.log(res.statusCode); },
  });
};
</script>
